<thought>To obtain the precursors, I first need the retrosynthetic template that corresponds to the described carbonyl‑ene transformation. I will search the template catalog using criteria that match the forward reaction (breaking a C=O and a C=C, forming a C‑C bond, an aliphatic OH and a five‑membered ring). Once I have the template ID, I will apply it to the target molecule SMILES to get all possible precursor sets.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "[CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketone", "C=C"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic hydroxyl", "five-membered ring"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C=O", "C=C"],
    "bonds_order_changed": ["C=O (2.0->1.0)", "C=C (2.0->1.0)"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
